current_date: Introduced January 2025 (stated on the Apply page; the PDF text itself carries no adoption date)
current_evidence: The joint Broadland/South Norfolk 'Apply' page says the Local Validation List was introduced 'From January 2025'. It links a 'Non Householder Local Validation List' (making-a-planning-application-2025-amends.pdf) and a separate 'Householder Local Validation List' (making-a-planning-application-householder.pdf), not the older file/4235 guidance notes.

issues.detail: Grokbot's link (downloads/file/4235) is the older 'Making a planning application – Non-householder Applications Guidance Notes'. That document calls itself 'Validation Guidance' and has no BNG, nutrient neutrality, fire statement or water efficiency items. The Apply page now links the January 2025 'Non Householder Local Validation List' (2025-amends PDF) and a separate 'Householder Local Validation List'.
issues.evidence: Apply page: 'Non Householder Local Validation List' -> /asset-library/making-a-planning-application-2025-amends.pdf; list introduced 'From January 2025'

issues.detail: List date 2022-01-01 comes from PDF metadata (CreationDate), not from document text. The current list was introduced in January 2025 according to the council's Apply page, so the 'Outdated (>2y)? = Yes' flag also rests on the wrong document.
issues.evidence: Reference row: 'Date basis: PDF metadata CreationDate'; Apply page: 'From January 2025'

issues.detail:
Many local requirements in the January 2025 Non-householder list are absent from the workbook:
- Accessible and Adaptable Housing Statement: major housing of 10+ dwellings/0.5 ha, excluding outline.
- Affordable Housing Statement: 10+ dwellings/0.5 ha, and exception sites.
- BNG: gain condition statement, statutory/small-sites metric, draft Biodiversity Gain Plan and draft HMMP. Applies to major applications after 12/2/2024 and minor after 2/4/2024.
- Building for a Healthy Life Assessment: 10+ dwellings.
- CEMP: major development.
- Delivery Statement: 100+ dwellings.
- Electric Charging Plan: new dwellings.
- Fire Statement: 18 m+/7+ storeys with 2+ dwellings, and any battery storage.
- Flood Risk Sequential Assessment.
- Footpath Diversion.
- Health Impact Assessment: 500+ dwellings on allocated sites or 100+ on non-allocated sites.
- Heritage Statement.
- Lighting Assessment.
- Marketing Evidence: loss of employment, Policy DM2.13/E2.
- Mineral Safeguarding: within Mineral Safeguarding Areas.
- Noise Impact Assessment: including ASHPs that are not PD.
- Planning Statement and Statement of Community Involvement: major development.
- Playing Fields Assessment.
- Retail Impact Assessment: South Norfolk thresholds of 1,000 sq m near Diss/Wymondham and 500 sq m elsewhere.
- Self/Custom Build statement.
- Structural Survey: listed building demolition, countryside barn conversions.
- Telecommunication Statement.
- Topographical Survey/Cross Section: slopes steeper than 1 in 14.
- Vehicle Tracking/Swept Path: 10+ dwellings.
- Water Efficiency Statement: all new residential.
- Utilities Assessment.
- Site Waste Management Plan: all non-householder new buildings or change of use.
issues.evidence: 2025-amends PDF Section 3 'Local validation requirements' and Section 4 'Additional supporting documents'

issues.detail: Householder shows '(none)', but the Householder Local Validation List sets local requirements. Tree survey: trees with a stem diameter of 75 mm or more within 15 m of new building works. Arboricultural implications assessment: groundworks within 2 m of the crown spread of significant trees. Flood risk assessment and drainage strategy: site in an area at risk of flooding (porosity test may be needed for soakaways or hard surfacing). Ecology survey: loss of trees, hedge removal or filling of a pond or ditch. Grokbot never read the householder list.
issues.evidence: Householder list: 'Ecology survey ... the loss of a tree/s, removal of a hedge or the filling in of any natural pond or ditch'

issues.detail: Viability Assessment is assigned to Outline, Reserved matters, LBC, Advertisement, LDC, Prior approval, s73, Discharge of conditions and NMA. The 'trigger' for each is a scrambled fragment of the application-type matrix ('Y = always needed ? ? ? = may be needed. 7 Tree works Outline Y Y ? ...'). The source requires a Viability Assessment only where a non-policy-compliant proposal is justified on viability grounds.
issues.evidence: Source: 'Viability Assessment - where an applicant argues economic viability to support a proposal that does not comply with policy'

issues.detail: 'Sunlight to gardens/amenity space / outdoor amenity' (under Full, Outline and Reserved matters) is not a requirement. Its trigger is glossary text from the Apply page defining outline and full applications. The source has no sunlight requirement.
issues.evidence: Grokbot trigger: 'in the garden area of a property Outline application - gives an agreement in principle to the proposal...'

issues.detail: Many triggers are cut-off fragments with no condition. Tree survey: 'works to BS 5837:2012.' (real trigger: trees 75 mm+ stem within 15 m). Open space: 'space and play areas.' (real trigger: exceeds Open Space SPD thresholds). Transport Assessment: 'with any Transport Assessment required.' (real trigger: use-class thresholds, e.g. dwellings over 100 units). DAS: 'in the design and access statement, should one be required.' Energy statement: no threshold (500+ dwellings or more than 50,000 sq m non-residential). Cycle parking and Waste/Refuse reuse the Landscaping trigger text.
issues.evidence: Grokbot trigger for Tree Survey: 'works to BS 5837:2012.'

issues.detail: Several triggers are matched to the wrong requirement. 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' uses the retail sequential test text about town centre vitality. 'Habitats Regulations Assessment' begins with Footpath Diversion text ('Where a development affects a definitive right of way'). 'Nutrient Neutrality' is triggered by 'new dwellings', but the current list applies it to any development creating overnight accommodation. GIRAMS (net increase in dwellings, including student/tourist accommodation) is not listed separately.
issues.evidence: 2025 list: 'Nutrient Neutrality - Any development creating overnight accommodation'; 'GIRAMS - Net increase in dwellings'

issues.detail: 'Biodiversity Checklist / Questionnaire' and 'Ecological Survey / Assessment' have identical text, both from the single 'Biodiversity survey and report' item. 'Cycle parking', 'Landscaping scheme' and 'Waste / Refuse' share the same landscaping sentence.
issues.evidence: Identical trigger: 'Biodiversity survey and report (Ecology Assessment) Where impacts upon a protected species...'

issues.detail: Some captured items are process text. Tab items: 'please ensure either all documents are submitted electronically or via a hard copy format' and 'For applications submitted via hard copy please send one copy'. 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' is advice to seek pre-app, not a validation requirement. The CIL row trigger is a general description of the levy rather than the form trigger (new dwellings or non-exempt development over 100 sq m).
issues.evidence: Tab item: 'For applications submitted via hard copy please send one copy.'

summary: Grokbot read the superseded non-householder guidance notes (file/4235, dated from PDF metadata). The current joint Broadland/South Norfolk lists, introduced January 2025, add about 30 local requirements (BNG, nutrient neutrality, fire statement, water efficiency, EV charging, etc.) and a householder list that Grokbot missed. Its Viability and 'Sunlight' rows are artefacts of garbled matrix and glossary text.
